value.name: answers uncertainty honestly
value.description: He admits that he does not yet know what he is going to be.

value.name: accepts honest answer
value.description: She tells him that his uncertainty is the only answer she will accept today and sets a Friday deadline.
evidence: "It is the only one," she said, "that I will accept from you today. Tell me by Friday."

value.name: urges independent decision
value.description: She tells him to choose based on what he wants rather than what he thinks she wants.
evidence: "Whichever you decide, decide it because it is what you want and not because it is what you think I want."

value.name: leaves dining room quietly
value.description: She ends the conversation, leaves the house, and only breathes fully after walking away two blocks.
evidence: She nodded once. She turned. She walked out of the dining room and down the hall and she let herself out the front door and she went down the stoop into the February morning and she walked two blocks before she allowed herself to take a full breath.

value.name: throws herself into work
value.description: That afternoon she focuses intensely on her legal work to reassure herself that she is still a practicing attorney.
evidence: In the office that afternoon she had three other matters to attend to and she attended to them with the efficient and slightly elevated concentration of a person trying to prove to herself that she was still a working attorney with a practice and not the housemother of a single dramatic estate.

value.name: handles routine legal matters
value.description: She returns calls, reviews a settlement statement, and meets with a new client about an intestate father's estate.
evidence: She returned calls. She reviewed a settlement statement in an unrelated matter. She had a forty-minute meeting with a new client whose father had died intestate in Bucks County and whose family situation, by the standards of the morning Asha had just had, was so straightforward as to be almost relaxing.

value.name: confirms inspection appointment
value.description: Beverly Ostrowski calls to confirm the Thursday inspection at ten.
evidence: At four-thirty she got a call from Beverly Ostrowski confirming the inspection for Thursday at ten.

value.name: receives email from Daniel
value.description: At the end of the workday she gets an email from Daniel that begins a consequential reply.
evidence: At five-fifteen she got an email from Daniel.
The email was three lines long.

value.name: reads Daniel's decision
value.description: Daniel writes that he has thought about her question and will not be retaining separate counsel.
